lines.text: The speaker tells his son to keep his commandments, which will add length of days and peace.
The son must bind loving devotion and faithfulness around his fingers and write them on the tablet of his heart.
The son is told to trust the LORD, acknowledge Him in all his ways, and fear the LORD.
The son is told to honor the LORD with his wealth, and then his barns will be filled with silver.
The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
